legend: Having a nice garden is hard, especially when you are obsessed about the aesthetics$$$aesthetics$$$. Such is the life of Ionel, who wants to have the prettiest garden he ever could. He also has a quite narrow point of view - in his eyes, flowers are either ugly or pretty - no in-between.

Therefore, to establish how beautiful a garden is, Ionel has patented a beauty coefficient. This coefficient is calculated as the number of squares that a garden has, such that the squares' perimeter is filled solely by beautiful flowers. In order to figure out how pretty his garden is, Ionel has tasked you with finding this coefficient.

Formally, you are given a matrix of size N×N$$$N \times N$$$, where 1≤N≤3×103$$$1 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^3$$$. Each cell of this matrix can either have value 0$$$0$$$, denoting an non-aesthetically pleasing flower, or value 1$$$1$$$, referring to a beautiful flower.
It is asked of you to compute the beauty coefficient B$$$B$$$ - the number of square submatrices in the matrix whose perimeter consists solely of the value 1$$$1$$$.
input: The first line of input contains one integers N$$$N$$$, denoting the length of the matrix. Note that 1≤N≤3×103$$$1 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^3$$$.

The next N$$$N$$$ lines will contain N$$$N$$$ integers aij$$$a_{ij}$$$, denoting whether the flower at cell (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ is pretty or not. Note that aij$$$a_{ij}$$$ may either be 0$$$0$$$ or 1$$$1$$$.
output: On a single line, print B$$$B$$$, the number of squares in the matrix whose perimeter is surrounded only by 1$$$1$$$s.

legend.ai: 拥有一个漂亮的花园很难，尤其是当你对美观$$$aesthetics$$$十分痴迷时。Ionel 的生活就是如此，他希望拥有自己能打造出的最漂亮的花园。他的观点也相当狭隘：在他眼中，花朵要么丑陋，要么漂亮，没有中间状态。
因此，为了确定一个花园有多漂亮，Ionel 为美丽程度申请了一项专利系数。该系数等于花园中满足以下条件的正方形数量：正方形的周长完全由漂亮的花朵组成。为了计算他的花园有多漂亮，Ionel 委托你求出这个系数。
形式化地说，给定一个大小为 N×N$$$N \times N$$$ 的矩阵，其中 1≤N≤3×103$$$1 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^3$$$。矩阵中的每个单元格的值可以是 0$$$0$$$，表示一朵不美观的花；也可以是 1$$$1$$$，表示一朵漂亮的花。
你需要计算美丽系数 B$$$B$$$，即矩阵中周长完全由值 1$$$1$$$ 组成的正方形子矩阵数量。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 N$$$N$$$，表示矩阵的边长。注意，1≤N≤3×103$$$1 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^3$$$。
接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行将包含 N$$$N$$$ 个整数 aij$$$a_{ij}$$$，表示单元格 (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ 中的花是否漂亮。注意，aij$$$a_{ij}$$$ 只能是 0$$$0$$$ 或 1$$$1$$$。

output.ai: 在一行中输出 B$$$B$$$，即矩阵中周长仅由 1$$$1$$$ 包围的正方形数量。
